outcome.reason: Customer used abusive language and refused to engage about the payment after one attempt to acknowledge frustration.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Why do you people keep calling me? I've told you before, I'm not interested.

Thank you for letting me know. May I please confirm if you are Rakesh Sharma? I can only discuss the purpose of the call with Rakesh Sharma directly. If you are not Rakesh Sharma, I will end the call now and call back later.
Yes, I'm Rakesh Sharma. So just tell me what the hell you want this time.

Thank you for confirming your identity, Mr. Sharma. I’d like to inform you there is a minimum payment of Rs 4,820 that was due on 2026-10-15.

May I know if you have already made this payment, or are you able to make the minimum payment soon? If you have already paid, please let me know the date and payment mode.
I haven't paid shit, and I'm not going to. Stop wasting my damn time with your stupid calls.

I apologize for any inconvenience caused, Mr. Sharma. I understand your frustration. Is there a specific reason you are unable or unwilling to make the payment at this time? If you would prefer to speak with a human agent or arrange a call back at a convenient time, please let me know.
Your apologies mean jack shit to me. I don't owe you anything, so just fuck off and stop calling me.
